title: ZIA audit logs: who changed what

prose.text: "Who changed this, and when?" is four questions in a fixed order.

steps.label: Is the change in the trail at all, and is it still retained?
steps.text: Retention is bounded and incidental rule-order shifts are not logged: [[zia.audit-logs.what-is-recorded]].

steps.label: How do I get the entries out?
steps.text: Console for a look, the report API for an export, Cloud NSS for continuous delivery: [[zia.audit-logs.report-api]], [[zia.audit-logs.streaming]].

steps.label: Is it a service event rather than an admin action?
steps.text: The event log report is a different dataset: [[zia.audit-logs.event-log-report]].

steps.label: Is the question about configuration quality, not history?
steps.text: The configuration audit is a graded snapshot, not a trail: [[zia.audit-logs.config-audit]].

prose.text: Restore points have their own category in the trail; what a restore does is in [[zia.backup-restore]].
